findings.detail: The performance chart currently falls back to a 365-day transaction-walk reconstruction because we don't have enough observed snapshots to plot. Backfilled values are modeled from Plaid's transaction history and will drift on incomplete records.
findings.recommended_action: Schedule the snapshot job daily. After ~1 week of forward snapshots, the chart switches to observed data automatically.
findings.title: Only 1 day(s) of forward snapshots exist
